meaning: Closes the #173 open premise STMT-MAXIME-ENS-IS-GOD (owner decision on #143, 2026-10-24): the maximum in being is unique and causes the being of all others, so by the open premise STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-UNIQUE-MAXIME-ENS (the reduced nominal description suffices; supported by q.13 a.8 ad 2 and et hoc dicimus Deum, which add conditions it drops) the name 'God' applies to it. The identification is nominal. Countermodels show that the description premise and uniqueness (hence Metaphysics II.1) are each needed.
